name: Bits & Bytes: The Visual Novel
source:
Based on the ongoing webcomic [url=http://bitsandbytescomic.tumblr.com/]Bits & Bytes[/url]. This is the story of Nolan Nett, owner, manager, and main chef at Bits & Bytes, a restaurant for Videogame Characters. The main "hook" of the webcomic is to see situations and events based on both videogame characters and their personalities, and current events and news of the videogame industry.

[Edited from [url=https://megawacky-max.itch.io/bybnovelavisual]itch.io[/url]]
